    Module @valon-technologies/gestalt

    Public API surface for executable Gestalt providers.

    Use this package to define provider runtimes, operation schemas, handlers, host-service clients, and provider-owned telemetry. The provider manifest still owns static identity, connections, hosted HTTP routes, passthrough surfaces, and release metadata.

    Example

    import { defineApp, ok, operation, s } from "@valon-technologies/gestalt";

    export const app = defineApp({
      displayName: "Example Provider",
      operations: [
        operation({
          id: "hello",
          input: s.object({ name: s.string({ default: "World" }) }),
          output: s.object({ message: s.string() }),
          async handler(input) {
            return ok({ message: `Hello, ${input.name}` });
          },
        }),
      ],
    });
